scope.later_delivery: Independent browser and native JavaScriptCore-plugin deliveries after initial desktop
deferred: Groovy/JVM plugin execution and binary compatibility
Material texture sampling/UV rendering, tags and saved scenes
scope.plugin_runtime: WebKit JavaScriptCore with a versioned handed-in application context

rules: Dependencies must be complete before a task changes shared contracts; independent evidence gathering may proceed.
Each slices entry is a separately assignable work unit. Large tasks require slice-level handoff; do not ask a small-context agent to absorb an entire source module.
Every implemented command/tool adds menu, button/palette, enabled-state, transaction and applicable scenario coverage.
Source behavior wins; document deliberate improvements and unsupported subsets.
T46 ratifies normalized object ownership, identity, layouts and migration before T02/T03/T05/T16 contracts harden.
Later JavaScriptCore plugins are required final-product work, isolated from initial desktop and browser release gates; no Groovy/JVM or developer CLI/TUI prerequisite.

T59 qualifies GPUI/raylib-rs viewport presentation and frame timing, with offscreen RenderTexture-to-GPUI-image as the current candidate; T60 removes retired Bevy/egui code only after replacement acceptance passes.

tasks.title: Capture legacy behavior, fixtures and measurement baseline
slices: Create a hashed fixture manifest from the 60 indexed model files; select small representatives for every payload family, gzip/history, glyphs and xref bundles. Keep large fixtures opt-in and reference originals by pinned hash.
Recover flat/rootGroup/prototype-only payloads from named historical commits using git show into isolated fixture files. Record actual writer/default assumptions; do not label absent version as v0.

Define canonical JSON comparison for geometry, transforms, IDs/colors/domain data and a scenario format for world pointer/key/command events. Capture legacy state/output where the existing app is runnable.
Record source-runtime launch/build prerequisites and reproducible performance setup. If the GUI cannot run, mark scenarios static-only or blocked with the exact reason; continue fixture/spec work.
done: Baseline manifest and scenario schema are committed without editing the legacy checkout.
Captured results distinguish executed assertions, static evidence and manual visual checks; no fabricated baseline timings.

tasks.title: Prove the Rust rendering, menu and geometry stack
slices: Select and lock toolchain/MSRV and dependency versions after a tiny native window/GPU/egui menu experiment. Demonstrate keyboard focus, IME/text input, viewport offset and platform menu feasibility.
Run concave polygon, nested hole, union/polygonization and near-collinear fixtures against candidate clipping/triangulation libraries; record exact supported operations and browser implications.
Demonstrate core/IO-compatible WASM compilation without native filesystem/HTTP/JVM dependencies; browser product integration remains later.
Record ADR04/05/09 choices, native-menu strategy, platform prerequisites and fallback policy. Remove throwaway experiments only after retaining reproducible evidence.
done: A buildable minimal workspace and evidence-backed ADRs exist.
Menus and polygon topology have proof cases before dependent tools are implemented; Android/Groovy/TUI are absent.

tasks.title: Implement numerical geometry and coordinate contracts
slices: Implement f64 vectors/planes/rays/affine transforms and separate point/vector/normal conversions, with named compatibility tolerances and quantization policies.
Implement plane projection, segment predicates, triangle queries, loop ordering/triangulation adapters and geometry diagnostics required by the selected kernel.
Freeze primitive math APIs, invalid/singular input handling and comparison policies; include small/large/local-parent cases.
done: C01/C02 numerical fixtures pass without GPU/UI dependencies.
Kernel choice and tolerance policy have one owner and no feature-local epsilon replacement.

tasks.title: Build canonical document stores, IDs and revisioned derived data
slices: Implement the T46 canonical ownership/identity decision: shared definitions and geometry bundles, placements/shared child layouts with explicit occurrence addressing, stable IDs and affine frames. Retain sparse domain payloads without requiring generators.
Separate authored instance edits from resolved caches and inheritance from explicit empty replacement; keep selection/edit mode in the session and define one effective-content query view.

Implement derived adjacency/bounds/reverse membership/index services with revision invalidation and safe direct-query fallback. No-op placements share source geometry; raw insertion does not perform topology repair.
done: Nested prototype/instance and raw insertion invariants pass.
Caches/session are excluded from canonical persistence and no UI/OS types enter core.
C32 ownership/no-op sharing cases pass; the Rust schema does not mirror duplicated legacy stores or per-occurrence cloned hierarchy.

tasks.title: Implement transactions and bounded undo
slices: Create begin/preview/commit/cancel boundaries with one ChangeSet and history entry per completed operation; start with affected-state/snapshot-backed history.
Implement redo branching, bounded memory/entries, labels, revision reporting and injectable clock. Specify camera/settings undo policy explicitly.
Define lazy legacy-history adapter interface and opaque preservation; integrate actual decoding when T05 is ready without making core depend on codecs.
done: Preview/cancel does not change history; failed operations publish no partial edits.
Legacy debounce divergence is documented and redo/cap tests pass.
Supported imported legacy snapshots are traversable lazily through the same bounded Undo/Redo timeline; corrupt entries remain diagnostic and do not alter the document.

tasks.title: Implement sparse legacy DTO reading and model/history containers
slices: Encode per-field defaults for all 32 DTO classes, preserving unknown nested fields and deferred/domain/instance override data. Decode current, prototype-only, rootGroup and fixture-proven flat layouts.
Read magic-detected gzip/JSON and base64/gzip undo snapshots with staged cancellation/progress; validate references and transforms off to the side.

Convert raw DTOs through the T46 normalized ownership/identity/layout rules without changing effective semantics. Collapse only proven no-op geometry snapshots, preserve authored/ambiguous differences and aliases, and provide schema-17-compatible export that re-expands content where required.
Run small fixture groups first, then all 60 and historical/error cases; record unsupported historical shapes precisely.
done: C03/C04 payload round trips preserve fields even before domain generators ship.
Empty/sparse axes are handled according to the documented validation/new-document policy; bad loads leave the live document intact.
Supported imported history snapshots connect lazily to desktop Undo/Redo; decode failures preserve their opaque entry and leave the document unchanged.

tasks.title: Create command registry and host-effect dispatch
slices: Define CommandId/descriptor/payload/result, enable/check queries, capability metadata and a deterministic application dispatcher.
Register canonical File/Edit/View/Render/selection actions for direct legacy UI callbacks plus preserved static/generated IDs; add typed setup/reset/camera/snapshot operations for tests.
Define host effects for dialogs/storage/capture/async jobs and action-tree metadata for menus/toolbars/palette/tutorials. Deferred commands are absent or explicitly unsupported.
done: One registry drives every presentation and exposes versioned schemas.
Dispatch versus completion and mutation versus tool activation are distinct in tests.

tasks.title: Build GPUI desktop window and raylib viewport with normalized input ownership
slices: Integrate event loop, GPU surface and basic faces/edges/grid/selection overlays using immutable render data and instance transforms.
Define a drawable viewport rectangle and normalized input/focus ownership; resize/DPI/device changes update camera mapping and resources coherently.
Implement normal executable file/size/version startup plumbing with a valid new document; no REPL/TUI, plugin host or self-updater.
done: A native desktop window renders a known transformed fixture and handles resize/close safely.
Core tests remain headless and platform services are isolated.

tasks.title: Implement GPUI desktop menus, grouped ribbon, and context command menu (#16, #17)
slices: Generate the textual menu row from the shared action tree, with enabled/checked state and commands routed to the common dispatcher.
Build the SolidCraft-style grouped, tabbed command ribbon from registered command metadata and existing toolbar/icon definitions.
Build searchable CADCraft-style Ctrl+Shift+P completion with shared availability, parameter schemas, keyboard navigation and feedback.
Expose the shared Tools context menu from the viewport without stealing input from active staged tools; keep its commands and state consistent with the palette.
Verify keyboard navigation, accessibility labels, focus restoration, shortcut suppression, resize/DPI and command mapping across all presentations.
done: The textual menu, ribbon, context menu and palette dispatch identical command IDs and reflect the shared enabled/checked state.
The shell remains visible and useful for an empty document, and text controls do not leak shortcuts or viewport events.

tasks.title: Implement desktop document service and safe storage
slices: Connect File commands/dialogs to staged candidate-document loading, progress/cancel and safe document publication.
Implement serialized immutable-revision saves, threshold compression, autosave debounce, Save As/default naming and temporary-file/atomic-replace recovery.
Connect legacy history adapter to native undo and reopen paths; inject failure/cancellation at every storage stage and reopen Rust output in Kotlin when runnable.
done: Last good file and current document survive load/save failure or cancellation.
Menu/button/typed command paths share storage behavior and successful saved revision.

tasks.title: Port orbit, orthographic and walkthrough cameras
slices: Port perspective orbit/pan/zoom and target synchronization against the declared viewport rectangle.
Implement six orthographic poses/projection/zoom and walkthrough movement/support/gravity/jump tuning.
Bind camera commands, profile-aware shortcuts and settings; preserve model camera versus runtime preference boundaries.
done: C09 project/unproject/navigation tests pass in both menu and button layouts.
No camera mode silently uses the wrong projection for picking.
Orbit input and restored perspective poses support pitch from −89° through +89° without reaching the singular camera poles.

tasks.title: Implement snapping, permanent grid and guides
slices: Port candidate generation/comparison in screen pixels with correct depth/priority and transformed visible groups; use correct stale-index fallback.
Implement permanent/adaptive grids, oriented plane/axis helpers, visibility/orientation/extent/spacing controls and virtual-plane fallback.
Register guide tools and G/T actions plus previews; verify helper spacing and orthographic behavior.
done: C10 covers every observed SnapType and visibility/local-context behavior.
Guides remain separate from authored geometry and do not become selectable ground.

tasks.title: Port mixed selection and semantic picking framework
slices: Implement click/add/remove, timed connected-coplanar double/connected triple click, instance edit entry and independent screen-window/crossing/world-volume workflows.
Centralize per-type visibility/lock/wireframe and selectable-handle dispatch; support domain handle providers added by later tasks.

done: C11 passes under transformed/occluded geometry; domain providers have C12 contract tests.
Timing is injectable and window versus volume selection remains distinct.
A live direction-coded marquee shows left-to-right containment and right-to-left crossing behavior; plain clicks toggle an already selected entity off.
A release from an actual viewport drag applies the visible left-to-right containment and right-to-left crossing marquee to scene geometry.

tasks.title: Implement tool protocol and line editing
slices: Freeze typed ToolEvent/state/preview/measurement and Line operator contracts with numeric/cancel dispatch. Transform-specific copy mode belongs to T15; hotspot placement remains a separate host-action mode, with hotspot definitions and attachments owned by T32.

Implement chained Line and single Construction Line with local-space segment insertion, edge splits/collinear consolidation. Preserve the current lack of automatic face cutting/inference in this path; explicit cutters ship in their owning tasks.

Specify line-chain transaction boundaries and Enter/Escape/Backspace behavior; expose operators through controls, palette and menus, and preserve source-order L/D/O/M cycles plus Ctrl+N distance input.
done: C02/C13 Line and Construction Line cases pass, including context isolation, raw-load isolation and no implicit face cuts.
Typed preview/commit parity, per-segment undo, keyboard cycles and the separate hotspot host-action route are covered.

tasks.title: Implement basic planar shape tools
slices: Implement ground/reference-plane and surface-aligned rectangles with shared edge/cut/triangulation operations.

Implement the three-pick parallelogram Quad and configurable-resolution Circle, preserving winding and numeric meanings. Batch isolated outlines and localize intersection repair to touched lines; preserve unrelated junctions, IDs and raw corner references.
Register previews/operators/menu paths; exercise degeneracy, reversed picks and rotated contexts.
done: All D02 tools pass C13 and cancel/undo semantics.
Quad is not implemented as an unrelated arbitrary four-point polygon.

tasks.title: Port transforms, stretch variants and painting
slices: Implement shared payload/source snapshot and coordinate transform operations; Move/Rotate/Scale reference stages, numeric control, axis constraints and copy mode. Ordinary edge/face transforms detach shared boundaries; explicit vertex edits and Stretch stay connected. Dedicated Move Copy/Rotate Copy commands must enable duplication and preserve sources (2026-10-20).
Implement Stretch/Stretch Scale/Rotate Stretch as separate state machines with immutable previews and source-characterized boundary behavior.
Implement face RGBA paint/current-color flow and prepare semantic/voxel/hotspot transform adapters for later tasks.
done: Transform-related C13/C15 assertions pass for selected raw mesh geometry and supported object occurrences; annotation and semantic/domain adapters follow their owning tasks.
No cumulative preview drift, shared-vertex double transform or unintended drawing-time auto-cut.

tasks.title: Implement reusable objects, placement and explode
slices: Implement grouping/create-prototype for source-supported payloads, shared child layouts, instance placement and occurrence-aware active-context/definition editing. Preserve legacy effective behavior through the T46 layout/identity decision.
Implement glue-to-surface alignment, nested transforms, duplication and definition deletion policy.
Implement explicit explode/materialization preserving parent-local coordinates, result selection and extensible domain/override resolution hooks.
done: C07/C08 pass for two shared instances, nesting and transformed explode.
Definition geometry stays distinct from per-instance overrides and closed-context cuts.

tasks.title: Complete GPUI inspectors, JSON-driven settings, preferences and command coverage (#26, #28)
slices: Implement selection/object/prototype/model/tool settings and registry-based panel visibility; later domain panels plug into this model.
Separate model settings, session selection/camera state and application preferences; validate fields and emit transactions only for valid edits.
Persist profile/layout and recover offscreen panels; complete current command/menu mapping, status/measurement/context feedback and shortcut focus tests.
Evaluate Ely GPUI under #26: pinned-source availability, component coverage, telemetry/supply-chain review, vendoring and GPUI upgrade difficulty before any production migration.
Active tools and stronger hover feedback (#28): show the active tool on its buttons and distinguish hover clearly, preserving icon and text labels.
Activate the Type/T/S/V/E/W selection table with per-type and whole-column controls, shared draw/edit/picking policy, and the user-specified shader defaults (2026-10-20).
done: Every ready operation is reachable in Desktop Menus and Buttons; no hidden-toolbar dependency.
C17/C23 pass after load, undo, field focus and profile switching.

tasks.title: Implement dimensions, bitmap text and vector glyph text
slices: Implement dimension start/end/offset calculations/render/pick/edit and bitmap screen/plane text metadata.
Load the embedded alphabet model/catalog and external glyph source, implement vector text tracking/line spacing/plane placement and fallback behavior.
Extend selection/transform/copy/panel/persistence paths and menu entries for all annotation types.
done: C14 annotations remain editable after copy/transform/reopen.
Glyph catalogs retain geometry and are not replaced with a bitmap font.

tasks.title: Implement paths, offsets, outlines and mesh creation
slices: Implement sampled line/arc/circle path stages, point undo, finish/cancel and arc-length subdivision settings.
Implement Double Line offsets/joins and shared loop/boundary ordering; expose reusable path generation to sweeps/domains.
Implement Mesh/Polyline Mesh/Face Outline/Line Offset prerequisites, selection/result and numeric behavior with command/menu registration.
done: C14 open/closed/concave path and boundary tests pass.
Face outlines do not emit every interior triangulation edge.
Shared endpoint ordering covers open, closed, disconnected and branched selections without dropping edges.
C14 covers Mesh, Polyline Mesh, Face Outline and Line Offset command selection, output, invalid-input and active-definition behavior.

tasks.title: Implement region push/pull
slices: Resolve selected/picked regions and shared boundaries, including holes and source-supported non-coplanar sets.
Implement signed extrusion with top/side faces, colors, previews, numeric distance and selection remapping.
Validate manifold prisms and no duplicate interior walls; add negative/zero/cancel/undo cases.
done: C13/C19 region extrusion cases pass.
Valid holes remain open and unsupported inputs fail without partial loss.

tasks.title: Port every copy and array state machine
slices: Write a compact per-tool state/count/endpoint/payload matrix; implement shared mixed-payload cloning and translation patterns. The existing numeric linear array must accept selected mesh entities as well as object occurrences, preserve source selection while creating copies, and select the generated results.
Implement Copy Multiple, planar and volumetric translation with exact count/extent/numeric semantics.
Implement planar/helicoidal rotate-multiple and Rotate2 reference stages separately from Rotate.
Implement fixed-step rotational/helical and equalized rotational/helical arrays; bound previews and retain result selection/undo behavior.
done: All ten ToolIds have source-characterized state tables and C15 cases.
Fixed-step versus equalized and Rotate versus Rotate2 distinctions remain visible.

tasks.title: Port hole/cutout algorithms and robust replacement
slices: Characterize prerequisites and distinct outputs of both registered hole variants and Cutout using selected edge/face loops.
Implement shared plane projection/fragment/inside classification and identity/color/selection remapping with atomic replacement.
Register all three IDs and validate nested/concave/disconnected/touching/tolerance failure cases against legacy fixtures.
done: C19 includes every cut variant and failure preservation.
No old ID is dropped just because another tool is named robust.

tasks.title: Port planar/spatial sweeps, ribbon and revolve
slices: Implement source profile/path selection and planar Extrude Swipe using shared path sampling.
Implement 3D frame transport and spatial swipe/ribbon corner/cap/seam behavior.
Implement revolve axis/angle/full-360/tessellation and typed inputs, with consistent winding/material/selection/undo.
done: C19 planar/spatial sweeps, ribbons, typed-angle Revolve and full-turn seam tests pass; closed Revolve profiles are manifold with outward winding and validated faceted volume.
Degenerate inputs fail safely; no implicit external CAD runtime is introduced.

tasks.title: Port plane section, plane cuts and mesh intersection
slices: Implement reusable triangle-plane and triangle-triangle intersection/fragment handling with stable tolerance policy.
Port each tool's source prerequisites, plane construction, keep-side/output rules and selected-result semantics.
Test transformed/no-hit/tangent/coplanar/open-surface cases and expose atomic fragment preparation for object booleans.
done: C19/C20 intersection cases pass and preparation is reusable by T27.
No nondestructive viewport clipping feature is accidentally substituted for modeling cuts.

tasks.title: Implement primitive mesh generators
slices: Extract per-primitive center/radius/height/orientation pick stages and tessellation rules.
Implement sphere/cylinder/cone/pill mesh generation with caps/seams/normals and configurable resolution.
Register menus/operators and use the generators as deterministic solids for later regression fixtures.
done: C19 ordinary primitives are closed/exportable under normal inputs.
Zero/negative dimensions and resolution bounds follow documented behavior.

tasks.title: Implement built-in mechanical tools
slices: Record actual profile/pick/pitch/count/tooth interpretation for each tool and reject ungrounded engineering guarantees.
Implement screw and washer generation using matching shared sweep/revolve/primitive operations.
Implement circular-hole and cog-wheel workflows including source selection, cutting, numeric controls, previews and export fixtures.
done: All four IDs pass mechanical C19/C20 cases and invalid-profile preservation.
Built-ins require no external plugin host or Groovy.

tasks.title: Implement object cutting and booleans
slices: Enforce exactly two sibling mesh instance prerequisites, operand ordering, nonempty geometry and voxel rejection.
Reuse intersection/cut preparation then classify fragments for cut-all/union/intersection/subtraction, preserving colors and reversed surfaces.
Commit loose selected geometry in the parent and remove source instances only on successful atomic completion; document differences for disjoint/coincident/invalid meshes.
done: C20 tests A−B/B−A, output context and source lifecycle explicitly.
Robustness limits and deliberate improvements are reported; no OpenSCAD dependency.

tasks.title: Implement voxel domain and tools
slices: Implement integer local cells/colors, canonical storage and revisioned surface generation with interior-face suppression.
Implement single/volume/frame tools, auto-context entry, selected cell actions and source-characterized range inclusion.
Integrate integer cell transforms, group transforms, selected-face voxelization, explode, panel/display filters and persistence regeneration.
done: C22 voxels and C15 transform/explode cases pass.
Generated voxel meshes are not separately authoritative saved edits.

tasks.title: Implement architecture walls, slabs and holes
slices: Implement canonical wall/slab/hole parameters, generated mesh attribution and auto-create/edit architecture contexts.
Port wall chain/inclination/joins and oriented slabs/holes; preserve colors and exact defaults.
Integrate semantic selection, endpoint/hole corner/edge/center handles, deletion, parameter panels, explode and one-pass load regeneration.
done: C12/C22 semantic edits affect parameters and correctly regenerated geometry.
Authored loose geometry survives save/reload without generated duplication.

tasks.title: Implement stairs and free-form frames
slices: Implement stair contour/walking-path/step/support/rail generation and source picking workflow.
Implement window/door free-form contour frames, width/depth/normal/glazing behavior and handle/panel controls.
Test new-tool versus persisted glazing defaults, regeneration, explode and canonical DTO round trips.
done: C22 contour stair/frame cases pass with editable parameters after reopen.
Frames are not restricted to outdated rectangle-only intent.

tasks.title: Implement HVAC plumbing and ventilation
slices: Implement canonical plumbing paths/diameter/sides and ventilation endpoints/binormal/dimensions/join/hump parameters.
Port path/duct generators and supported turns/joins/crossings, keeping source semantic attribution.
Integrate control handles, selection/deletion, panels, transforms/explode and regeneration/load without inventing an on-disk HVAC prototype kind.
done: C12/C22 HVAC cases pass with stored parameters and correct default values.
Built-in domain code remains independent of external plugin execution.

tasks.title: Implement hotspot definitions, IDs and attachment graph
slices: Implement definitions for eight operations/five marker shapes, reference position, stable vertex/segment/triangle and hotspot attachments.
Port placement action/mode outside ToolId, attach/select-reference controls, panel defaults and selection/handle behavior.
Characterize attachment evaluation ordering, preserve legacy quantization fallback, and diagnose missing/cyclic references with bounded graph traversal.
done: C15 graph/attachment/panel cases pass and stable references survive topology remapping.
No extra fabricated hotspot ToolId or accidental vertex re-identification is introduced.

tasks.title: Implement dynamic hotspot instance evaluation
slices: Implement deterministic resolve-from-prototype evaluation for transform operations and attached-hotspot cascades.
Implement multiplication operations through shared payload/copy generators, including per-instance attachment/position overrides.

Cache effective geometry/annotations by authored definition and occurrence-input revisions, sharing unchanged content. Integrate preview/cancel/undo/prototype changes/copy/explode and preserve genuine legacy authored or unexplained override snapshots.
done: Two instances with different states remain independent and reopen correctly.
No cumulative preview mutation or stale derived geometry after definition edits.

tasks.title: Implement external prototype references
slices: Define relative/absolute resolution and canonical link metadata, cycle/missing detection and refresh diagnostics.
Implement external definition load/save and container stripping rules while retaining instance hotspot overrides.
Integrate Objects panel/menu commands and atomic multi-file failure policy; test bundled current xrefs and unresolved preservation.
done: C16 completes without empty external-file overwrite or loss of instance state.
No browser filesystem/Android URI emulation is added prematurely.

tasks.title: Implement random offset, surface scatter and both remesh modes
slices: Port shared-vertex normal offset and bounds/settings; add explicit seeded operation inputs for deterministic automation.
Implement payload/target face separation, area/sample distribution, normal alignment/scale/rotation fuzz and instance/raw payload support for scatter.
Implement planar regular-grid versus surface-remesh modes separately with tolerance/subdivision controls, source replacement and validation.
done: C21 geometric/statistical invariants pass for all four IDs.
No tests assert exact unseeded legacy random output.

tasks.title: Implement OBJ/STL/DXF interchange and unit policy
slices: Record supported OBJ/STL/DXF parser/entity subsets and scene/selection export semantics; choose independent example fixtures.
Implement OBJ geometry/normals, STL binary/ASCII/auto, DXF triangles/lines and physical-unit/coordinate scaling conversions.
Connect cancellable import/export commands/dialogs and diagnostics; compare legacy outputs and external fixtures, not only self round trips.
done: C27 common-format/unit matrix passes with supported-loss reporting.
No double scaling or lost DXF line-only scenes.

tasks.title: Implement extended mesh formats
slices: Write exact FBX/glTF/GLB/DAE/3MF/AMF support ledger from current parser branches, example files and nested/unit transforms.
Implement FBX ASCII output and supported FBX input, glTF/GLB buffers/accessors/geometry, DAE geometry/units with measured library adapters.
Implement ZIP/XML 3MF components/build transforms/unit handling and indexed-mesh validation, plus AMF; retain source-supported errors.
Run external/legacy fixtures for all formats and document unsupported animation/material/texture/semantic data rather than claiming complete format support.
done: C27 extended-format matrix passes with explicit subset ledger.
3MF closure/edge diagnostics and component scaling are tested independently.

tasks.title: Implement IFC4 proxy export and supported geometry import
slices: Characterize actual IFC geometry import subset and IFC4 project/site/building/storey/proxy output.
Implement world-resolved mesh/line/dimension chunks, names/spatial containment/units and source-equivalent representations.
Connect selection/model export paths and validate mixed-domain examples; document that semantic IfcWall/IfcSlab property modeling is future scope.
done: C27 IFC classes/geometry/units assertions pass.
No inferred semantic BIM completeness is advertised.

tasks.title: Complete real-time lighting, shadows and view capture; remove mesh triangulation seams (#13)
slices: Implement directional/ambient/specular/alpha lighting and explicit conversion from persisted legacy shadow settings into the new pipeline.
Implement supported shadow filtering/quality controls, stable bounds/ground and readable overlay/transparent composition.
Implement model/UI inclusion-aware GPU PNG capture and current-view SVG output with completion notifications and fixed-camera comparisons.
Hide coplanar shared mesh edges from filled rendering while retaining true mesh boundaries, explicit construction lines and visible edges across a crease (#13).
done: C24 covers lights/shadows/alpha/overlays and menu-dependent viewport offsets.
Front/back face colors preserve the darker, slightly bluer back-face appearance, and shadow maps cast entity shadows onto ground and other entities.
Coplanar triangles retain one rendered orientation across shared edges, including edges whose endpoints have coincident positions but distinct vertex IDs.
Capture dispatch success is distinct from a completed fresh output file.
Filled coplanar mesh triangles render as a continuous surface without triangulation seams; boundary and non-coplanar edges remain visible (#13).

tasks.title: Port progressive CPU offline rendering
slices: Implement immutable resolved scene/camera/light snapshots and deterministic tile scheduler/progress/cancel lifecycle.
Port raytrace then pathtrace shading/sampling, resolution/workers/pruning/transmission/light controls with numeric image tests.
Implement preview/composite/output buffers, safe stale-result policy and PNG save; leave platform scheduling injectable for later browser work.
done: C25 cancellation/worker/progress/image export cases pass without UI freezes or model mutation.
Offline settings and menu/button controls share commands.

tasks.title: Implement structured automation and regression dispatcher
slices: Port supported loopback REST aliases and JSON-RPC discovery/command/pointer/status/resource schemas with application-owner dispatch.
Publish honest capability/protocol negotiation and unsupported Groovy-console behavior; retain supported k3d tool/resource names.
Expose typed reset/geometry/selection/camera/snapshot/save helpers and completion revisions for deterministic scenarios without REPL/Groovy.
Implement timeout/cancel/log/validation cases and run menu/button/HTTP equivalence regressions.
done: C18/C28 retained subset passes and clients need no sleeps or JVM dependency.
Unsupported console/plugin tools are not advertised as functional.

tasks.title: Audit phase-specific capabilities and preserve migration boundaries
slices: Retain legacy Groovy/JAR/TUI entry points and sample metadata for source/API ports. Record required later JavaScriptCore plugin tasks and SDK direction without adding the runtime to initial desktop.

Check initial menus/launch help/automation omit or explain unavailable plugin/Groovy/console actions; capability reporting must distinguish planned JavaScriptCore plugins from unsupported Groovy compatibility.
Verify unknown/deferred nested document data survives editing/saving known fields and that domain built-ins do not accidentally depend on PluginHost.
done: Initial desktop runtime needs no JVM/Groovy/plugin/TUI dependency.
Legacy/deferred data survives; final-product JavaScriptCore support is tracked as required later delivery rather than an unspecified optional plugin ABI.

tasks.title: Implement desktop tutorial recorder/player and schema adapters
slices: Implement desktop action observation/matching, recording, before/after previews and player navigation/pause/stop.
Keep separate typed adapters for desktop action schema and docs-site browser schema; preserve manual/pending flags.
Route menu/button/tool completions through shared tutorial action IDs and migrate representative tutorial workflows with explicit assertion status.
done: C29 verifies matching and manual status without inventing full input replay.
Browser adapter has no dependency on desktop HTTP or Groovy.

tasks.title: Qualify desktop performance, complete UI coverage and package releases
slices: Run whole feature/format/document matrices and complete menu mapping for all 74 built-ins plus non-tool actions; audit enabled/checked/focus behavior on each desktop OS.
Measure T00 scenarios and optimize demonstrated bottlenecks only: raw load, revisioned indexes, orthographic queries, frustum culling, incremental chunks, preview and undo memory.
Record deliberate differences, known unsupported subsets and executed versus manual results. Resolve release naming/app IDs/aliases without changing legacy file meaning.

Package Linux/Windows/macOS builds, provenance/assets/docs/command references and install/open/save/export/close smoke tests. Enforce no Android/Groovy/TUI requirement. Prepare the manual six-native-target pipeline with existing-tag dispatch, literal app-version matching, audited old-glibc Linux compilation, portable ZIP/tar.gz plus AppImage/Snap/MSI/MSIX/DMG, mandatory complete-matrix digests, and deferred MSIX signing (2026-10-20). Native GUI qualification remains separate.
done: All initial desktop requirements are mapped to passing evidence or explicitly reviewed limitations; no placeholder command counts as complete.
C23/C26/C31 report is concrete and desktop release is independent of browser delivery.

tasks.title: Deliver browser runtime, component and docs integration
slices: Implement Rust/WASM platform adapter for file picker/download/storage and cooperative jobs with capability-aware UI.
Preserve custom-element methods/properties/events/command payloads, async correlation, focus/scroll/resize behavior and explicit single-editor scope.
Connect retained docs-site/tutorial adapters and generated tool/command references; validate actual browser/backends and record unsupported native capabilities.
Run standalone and embedded C30 plus browser tutorial checks; Android remains separate future work.
done: Browser delivery meets its separate C30 gate and requires no local desktop HTTP/JVM service.
Existing component API consumers have a documented compatibility/migration report.

tasks.title: Ratify the normalized object model and migration contracts
slices: Use the completed object-model audit/census as input; produce a field/operation owner-lifetime-persistence table distinguishing authored definitions/occurrence edits, derived caches, UI session and legacy metadata. Confirm reachability rather than treating unused helpers as behavior.

Compare a per-bundle stable vertex/indexed-primitive representation with a minimal alternative on real/synthetic fixtures; specify coincident independent vertices, quantized aliases, topology remaps, face colors and optional nonidentity definition frames.

Classify no-op versus authored/ambiguous geometry overrides, explicit empty replacements, domain output provenance and legacy export materialization. Preserve differing snapshots and unknown data.

Record selected canonical schema, effective-content query/edit contracts, migration examples and measured comparison; ratify C32 invariants before T02/T03/T05/T16 implementation. Public plugin context uses those identities rather than legacy stores.
done: One authored owner per value; base geometry, actual instance edits and generated caches have distinct types and rules.

Schema/alias/migration examples cover no-op sharing, meaningful differences, empty overrides, hierarchy variants, domain provenance and nonidentity frames; coordinate coincidence alone never forces welding.
Decision and fixture assertions are concrete enough for small-context core/IO/object/plugin agents to consume without repeating the investigation.

done: Native JSC proof and packaging matrix cover all supported desktop OSes with concrete artifacts/checks or recorded platform blockers.
SDK/bootstrap/promise/executor/lifetime policy is evidence-backed; no Groovy/JVM/Node/DOM or silent alternate native engine.

tasks.title: Implement JavaScriptCore runtime lifecycle and context facade

Implement async request correlation/runtime executor delivery and document-close/unload behavior without transferring JS values or mutable model references across owners.

done: Context/lifecycle tests pass under GC, callback errors, reload and pending completion after close/unload.
The facade owns host-service handles and value DTOs, not mutable legacy/Rust object graph wrappers.

tasks.title: Connect the versioned JavaScript plugin SDK to normalized host services
slices: Expose targeted/paged authored and effective-content queries, occurrence-aware selection, stable IDs, source attribution and revision-scoped generated handles. Avoid full-model copies on every event.

Expose declarative panel and import/export adapter registrations through shared menu/UI/codec host services; enable/check state never depends on unbounded JS every frame.

Implement disposable/coalesced event subscriptions, versioned namespaced document state, separate app settings and SDK declarations/examples. Unknown plugin state survives absence; runtime JS heap is never persisted.
done: C18/C32/C33 establish menu/command/undo equivalence, authored-versus-resolved identities, stale-revision rejection and absent-plugin state preservation.
Published ctx v1/schema and SDK types do not freeze canonical storage internals; custom plugin entity schemas are not invented implicitly.

tasks.title: Deliver JavaScriptCore plugin UX, samples and qualified desktop packages
slices: Implement local plugin install/discover/enable/disable/reload/remove and diagnostic UI using shared menus/panels; do not add an unrelated marketplace or REPL.

Publish API/version/capability/plugin-state compatibility and supported-platform report, provenance/update ownership and browser limitations. Required native plugin delivery qualifies independently of browser release.

Initial desktop has no mandatory runtime dependency; no Groovy/JVM binary compatibility or CLI/TUI is reintroduced.

tasks.title: Restore and verify geometric feedback in the raylib viewport (#2, #21)
slices: Inventory the currently enabled geometry commands and every pending pick stage or parameter preview; identify gaps in geometry and vector feedback, treating Select as the sole exception.

Add snapped-point previews for each stage, preferring generated geometry and otherwise drawing the previous-point-to-pointer vector with length and signed ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ in model units to at most three decimals; include Paint target and selected-object Array previews. GPUI pointer updates must reach Push/Pull and specialized tool states before preview calculation; use model-width strokes after face fills.
Use the same computed transform, snap, numeric override and active-definition coordinates for preview and commit; preserve per-tool point sequences and cancel behavior.
Add C34 coverage across all enabled geometry tools for stage progression, preview/commit parity, units, snapping, cancellation and invalid input.
done: Every enabled tool that constructs or changes geometry gives live preview at each pending pick or parameter stage; only selection is exempt.
Vector feedback shows distance and relative coordinates, and preview data agrees with committed geometry for snapped, numeric and entered-definition workflows.

tasks.title: Organize Tools menu into toolbar groups and favorites (#3)
slices: Map each built-in tool command to its legacy toolbar submenu from the source-backed toolbar definitions; keep unassigned and contextual commands in clear groups.
Expose Select, Line, Rectangle, Circle, Push/Pull, Move, Copy, Rotate and Stretch as direct Tools-menu entries while preserving their grouped primary paths and shared command behavior.
Cover grouped and favorite menu navigation, capability-aware disabled entries, and command parity through menu activation; retain complete palette discovery.
done: The Tools menu is organized into named toolbar submenus instead of a flat legacy-tool list.
Frequently used tools and copy remain directly available, and menu aliases dispatch through the same registry commands as grouped entries and the palette.

tasks.title: Delete selected mesh entities and object instances (#4)
slices: Implement an atomic Delete Selection operation for supported selected object occurrences, vertices, segments and triangles, preserving shared definitions and nested occurrence isolation.

Enable Delete Selection for every valid supported selection and route the command, Delete key and Edit/menu/button entry through the same undoable operation; report unsupported or stale targets without partial edits.
Cover realistic viewport selections, mixed and nested selections, dependent mesh topology, active-instance isolation, command-state readiness, undo/redo and every user-facing Delete route.
done: Selecting any supported object or mesh entity and invoking Delete removes the intended selection, clears removed targets and creates one undo step; undo and redo restore the corresponding document states.

Delete Selection is enabled for valid supported selections and behaves identically through the palette, Delete key and Edit menu/button; invalid or unsupported selections fail atomically with a clear diagnostic.

tasks.title: Persistent oriented cursor and context-safe guide placement (#8, #9, #14, #15)
slices: Expose the latest snapped or free construction point as a viewport cursor throughout all active tool states.
Render an oriented cursor basis and guide axes with red horizontal tangent, green remaining tangent and blue surface-normal conventions for level and slanted surfaces.

Make guide commands and G/T place at the current cursor without changing active tools, accepted picks, previews or document history; retain selector click placement when there is no cursor point and reject missing points during an in-progress tool without state loss.
Add C36 regression coverage for cursor basis, both guide kinds, staged-tool context preservation, missing cursor handling and selector fallback.
Orient the cursor on a snapped segment with blue along the segment, red parallel to the ground and green along the remaining orthogonal direction (#14).
Reduce the cursor to colored axis segments without arrowheads and a final screen-space center bullet; render selected vertex markers as small red screen-space bullets (#15).
done: Cursor and guide orientation use the snapped surface normal with a horizontal red tangent and orthogonal green tangent.
Guide placement at the cursor preserves all in-progress tool state and performs no document edit.
Segment cursor orientation follows the segment and ground basis; the cursor has no arrowheads and selected vertex markers are small red screen-space bullets (#14, #15).

tasks.title: Add a persistent recent project list (#10)
slices: Persist a bounded, de-duplicated list of up to ten successfully opened project paths in application preferences; failed and cancelled loads do not update it.
Expose recent projects in the File menu and provide a command-palette route that lets the user choose an entry; reuse the normal load/replacement flow.
Cover ordering, duplicate promotion, the ten-entry cap, persistence, stale paths, failure/cancel behavior, and menu/palette parity under C37.
done: The latest ten successfully opened projects persist newest-first across application restarts, with duplicates moved to the front.
Recent projects open through the same safe loader from both File and the command palette; failed/cancelled loads leave the list unchanged.

tasks.title: Make Cuboid a two-point primitive (#11)

Replace the ground-rectangle-plus-height workflow with two snapped opposite 3D corners, a matching preview, and a closed cuboid committed to the active scene graph.
Cover both pick orders, non-ground corners, preview/commit bounds and feedback parity, degeneracy, active definitions, selection, undo/redo and Escape under C38.
done: Cuboid is discoverable under Primitives and requires exactly two opposite-corner picks in three dimensions.
Preview and committed geometry share the same snapped bounds, active-graph owner, selection and undo behavior.

Build a vertical slice that loads the authoritative Meshcraft document, renders resolved scene geometry as GPU meshes with camera, grid and lighting, and routes edits through the existing command/document services.
Port desktop menus, floating toolbars, palette, inspectors, status and viewport input incrementally to Bevy UI while preserving shared command IDs and active tool/session state.

Measure frame and hover latency on a reproducible scene with at least 2,000 entities to address the performance report in #18; cache stable meshes/transforms and use spatial queries so pointer movement does not rebuild or scan the full scene.
Carry viewport correctness requirements for two-sided face rendering, cursor/guides, selection and both-direction window selection into the Bevy renderer and UI acceptance tests.

The unfinished application shell and UX requirements are explicitly superseded by high-priority issue #20 and replacement task T58; closing T57 does not claim Bevy UI parity or resolve the #18 performance benchmark.

Verify resize/DPI mapping, clipping and z-order, focus, pointer and keyboard ownership, latest-frame backpressure, event-loop/render-thread rules, window close and resource destruction on the target Linux session.
Define the versioned, framework-neutral viewport input/event and scene snapshot/delta contract; high-frequency camera/pointer state remains local to the viewport.
Record measured behavior, dependency revisions, limitations and a go/no-go result before the full migration proceeds.

Text menus open populated disabled command lists, ribbon tabs switch populated command groups, and all command buttons remain disabled in the stack proof.
Viewport input, focus, resize/DPI, clipping/z-order and shutdown pass on the explicitly recorded target Linux window backend, including the dense-array frame budget.
The renderer/session boundary is typed and framework-neutral; core and commands do not depend on UI or GPU crates.
Dependency versions and reproducible proof commands are recorded; Windows/macOS support is not claimed without separate verification.

Shared command IDs, JSON payload definitions, headless dispatch, transactions, undo, object model and IO behavior remain covered and independent of GPUI/raylib.
